message.content: The last common ancestor of lions (Panthera leo) and zebras (Equus quagga) was a small, early mammal that lived roughly 70–80 million years ago, before the evolutionary split between the orders Carnivora (lion’s lineage) and Perissodactyla (zebra’s lineage).
